plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 from the official University of Washington Bothell degree-map PDF 'B-Physics-BS-Degree-Map-2022.pdf' (printed footer 'Last updated: 09/22/2022'), hosted on uwb.edu. The map's title block prints 'Physics (BS)'. Filed under catalog_year 2022-2023: this is an ARCHIVED map, not the current catalog. The current UW Bothell catalog is 2026-2027, and the degree maps the site currently links to are UW NetID SharePoint Word documents and MyPlan, both login-walled; no login was attempted, so the public 2022 PDF is the newest publicly verifiable official term-by-term map for this program. The map calls itself 'a suggested schedule of courses based on degree requirements' and 'not a substitute for academic advising' (printed on the map). UW Bothell is a quarter-system school; the 12 blocks below are the map's 12 quarters (Autumn/Winter/Spring, Years 1-4) in printed order. The map prints no per-term totals and no degree total. RECONCILIATION: applying the map's own printed credit rule (5 credits unless a parenthetical number is printed) to every printed cell, this plan sums to exactly 180, the standard UW Bothell bachelor's total — the printed exceptions below 5 (CSS 112 at '(4 credits)', B PHYS 231 at '(3 credits)', the B PHYS 494 seminar at '(C/NC; 1 credit)', and the final-year 'Elective/Minor Coursework' slot annotated '(2 credits; ...)') are balanced by the four-row quarters the map prints in Years 3 and 4 (Year 3 Winter and Spring and Year 4 Autumn and Spring print a fourth row that is blank as printed and carries no course; Year 4 Winter prints four filled rows and sums to 17). Parenthetical credit exceptions recorded exactly: CSS 112 (4); B PHYS 231 (3); B PHYS 494 (1); the Year 4 Winter Elective/Minor slot (2). Non-credit parentheticals transcribed on the titles/notes, never read as credits: STMATH 207 carries '(prerequisite for B PHYS 222 but may be taken concurrently)'; B WRIT 135 carries '(or other 5 credit W course)'; the Year 4 Autumn B PHYS Elective carries '(recommended BPHYS 317, a prerequisite for BPHYS 450)'; B PHYS 431 carries '(or in WIN BPHYS 450 or BPHYS 432)' — the corresponding Year 4 Winter slot 'BPHYS 450 or 432 (if not BPHYS 431 in AUT)' is recorded as a choice slot with exactly those two printed options and a synthetic code; B PHYS 484 carries '(also a W and SSc)'. Markers are disclosed, not recorded as prerequisites (the map prints no course-to-course prerequisite chain, so no prereqs are recorded): the diamond means 'Prerequisite: Required to apply for major'; the checkmark means 'milestones: Courses & requirements needed to progress'; the four-point marker means 'fulfilled with Discovery Core'; this map prints no star legend. The map's cells print the code form 'B PHYS' while its notes print 'BPHYS' — codes are recorded as printed in the cells and the variant is disclosed here. Competitive-applicant guidance printed on the map (all prerequisites completed, 3.0 grade in each prerequisite, cumulative GPA 3.0; most satisfactory applicants typically but not always admitted) is disclosed here and not encoded. Per-year printed notes: Year 1 — the calculus prerequisite chain into STMATH 207/208/224 and BPHYS 222/221 (STMATH 207 may be taken concurrently with them). Year 2 — completion of 200-level Physics (BPHYS 224, 222, 221) and 200-level Math (STMATH 207, 208, 224). Year 3 — BPHYS 231 is the prerequisite for BPHYS 431/432; BPHYS 231 and 431 are offered only in Autumn, so BPHYS 231 must be taken no later than Autumn of Year 3; students select one of BPHYS 431 (AUT), BPHYS 432 (WIN) or BPHYS 450 (WIN).
